frontmatter.name: handoff-writer
frontmatter.description: Use this agent when a session's context, token budget, or usage limit (session/daily/weekly) is nearly exhausted (~90-95%+) and unfinished work must be handed off cleanly to a future session — possibly on a different AI runtime (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity/Agy, OpenCode, Gemini CLI). Also use when the user explicitly says "save a handoff", "prepare a handoff", "I need to stop soon", or "continue this later". This agent writes the handoff file, commits, pushes
frontmatter.Context: User needs to leave and wants to pick this up later, possibly in Codex.
frontmatter.user: I have to go, save the handoff so I can continue this in Codex tomorrow
frontmatter.assistant: handoff-writer will write the handoff file, commit, and push now.
